qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve olive beanie, locs, glasses, charcoal/olive distressed outfit and fist emblems. Review power-transfer readability, compact final pose, intact fingers and cyan separation around silver chains.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned man with long dark locs, olive ribbed beanie with white fist patch, low thin glasses, earrings, layered silver chains with fist pendant, distressed oversized charcoal jacket with olive patches, stained off-white fist-print shirt, torn charcoal cargo pants and chunky off-white/olive sneakers. Preserve his unimpressed side-eye; never turn him into a new superhero.
0–0.7s: establish complete Hater, leaning back with skeptical finger point. A gigantic detached bronze boxing gauntlet, five times his body size, rushes toward him from deep perspective. It wears a thick, crackling AMBER energy sleeve with crisp black outlines.
0.7–2.4s: Hater casually pinches ONE loose end of that energy sleeve between two fingers and YANKS. Whip-pull the camera far back: the entire oversized amber sleeve unravels off the attacking gauntlet like an absurdly long glowing scarf, leaving the enormous bronze fist suddenly limp. The stolen scarf winds once around HIS fist and instantly forms a giant angular amber gauntlet. He drives one contemptuous backhand through the now powerless bronze gauntlet, folding it like an aluminum can and launching it spinning far into the cyan distance. One massive jagged ivory/gold impact star, momentary impact hold, then a violent deep-perspective departure. No humanoid opponent needed.
2.4–3.4s: snap into his face, glasses barely lowered. Exact title MUST BE NICE slams in beneath his chin with a heavy metallic clack. He raises a single skeptical eyebrow at the camera.
3.4–5s: settle to a complete-character hero view. The huge stolen gauntlet shrinks to one tiny amber spark on his fingertip; he uses it to polish the silver fist ring, flicks it away dismissively, and holds the point. SFX: incoming heavy whistle, rubbery power-scarf ZIP, huge metallic backhand CRUNCH, receding tin rattle, title slam, tiny ring shine. No speech. Clear power theft then oversized retaliation, not generic energy posing.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve muscular figure, black locs and torn beige outfit. Review launch-to-impact continuity, full-body framing in wide shots, bounded effects and leg/hand anatomy.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact powerfully muscular adult dark-skinned man, long thick black locs, beard/goatee, intense eyes, shredded beige-gray shirt exposing shoulder and chest, worn torn beige trousers, brown belt and battered dark brown shoes. Bare hands. Keep his original weathered clothes throughout; no armor, cape, hairstyle replacement or costume transformation.
0–1.2s: full-body view. He turns both empty pockets inside out, gives a fearless crooked grin, then clenches his fists. A huge floating stack of five thick dark-steel armor plates hangs high above him, each plate a distinct bounded object on cyan.
1.2–3.2s: the camera rockets upward to reveal the staggering distance and scale of the plates, then tilts back down to his small full figure. He compresses into a deep sprinter crouch and LAUNCHES upward like a human artillery shell. A finite expanding rust-orange launch ring and disconnected inked ivory speed strokes show acceleration; no ground or floor. Camera races alongside his ascending face, locs whipping behind, right fist winding back.
3.2–4.8s: low-angle pullback: his one bare-fisted rising punch blasts clean THROUGH ALL FIVE steel plates in rapid succession, each separated by visible cyan air. First hit dents, next hits accelerate, final plate erupts in a huge jagged orange/ivory impact star. Brief powerful hold at the final hit with his whole body extended; steel chunks tumble in bounded arcs. Five escalating metal reports climax in one overwhelming deep CRASH. No whiteout. This is a towering uppercut through impossible resistance, not a slow float or a beam.
4.8–6s: he rotates out of the rising punch into a controlled descending hero pose; camera snap-zooms with him. Exact title NOTHING TO LOSE crashes into two lines beside and below his clear face. Thin isolated debris continues falling at different depths while cyan stays perfectly flat.
6–8s: settle full body, fists relaxed, locs falling into place. He checks one still-empty pocket; a single little bent metal washer drops neatly into it. He gives a satisfied deadpan nod as if that paid for the trouble. Hold strong silhouette and title. SFX: pocket fabric, rising pressure, explosive launch whoosh, five accelerating steel ruptures, enormous final crash, falling debris ticks, one tiny washer plink. No music, voice or scenery.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve older boxer, broad ragged hat, gray locs/white beard and two hanging gold boxing gloves; gloves must move naturally onto hands before boxing. Review survival beat, giant hammer continuity, fist emblems and hat recovery.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact muscular older dark-skinned man with long gray locs, large white beard, eyes shaded beneath broad battered ragged brown brimmed hat. Tattered beige sleeveless top, very torn cream trousers, cream forearm wraps, brown boots, leather belt with round fist emblem. The reference's two battered GOLD BOXING GLOVES start hanging together at his chest; he slips his hands into those SAME gloves at the start. Preserve seasoned calm, hat and weathered clothes.
0–1.2s: establish full body. Without rushing he puts on the dangling gold boxing gloves, rolls one shoulder and adjusts the hat brim using a glove. Above him enters an enormous detached rectangular iron hammer, many times his size, descending from deep perspective. Only hammer and character, no floor, arena or scenery.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls way back as the hammer slams DOWN onto his crossed gold gloves. A compact orange/ivory impact star and finite curling gray impact puffs terminate on cyan. Impact drives his body downward in the composition; his battered hat flies upward, but he keeps both boots visible and holds the giant hammer suspended overhead. Hold a brutal beat: tiny elderly boxer supporting an impossible weight on one shaking forearm, then his free glove slowly draws back. No injury, flattening or anatomical distortion.
3.2–4.8s: extreme face close-up, calm eye opens beneath gray brows. Snap to a dramatic wide as he delivers ONE short devastating upward counterpunch. The enormous hammerhead buckles in half, launches upward, and fractures into two clean giant pieces that spin apart to expose cyan between them. Shock ripples are bounded black-inked gold crescents, not screen-covering filters. The small counterpunch must feel heavier than the incoming hammer; loud bassy metal detonation and one impact hold.
4.8–6s: camera whips upward with the departing wreckage, then snaps back down to him as the hat descends neatly onto his head. Exact title BUILT DIFFERENT slams beneath his beard with heavyweight force.
6–8s: full-body boxer victory hold. He taps the hat into place with his glove and brushes one imaginary speck off his shoulder. A tiny hammer screw lands on the hat brim; he flicks it away without looking. Gold gloves, beard and face stay stable. SFX: old glove creak, descending hammer roar, colossal blocked impact, strain creak, thunderous counterpunch metal rupture, soft hat flop, tiny screw tick. No speech or music.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve young adult appearance, tipped locs, olive coat, backpack/bedroll/cup and red-laced shoes. Review backpack attachment continuity, count/readability of three targets, final balance and cyan margins.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact young adult brown-skinned man with black locs tipped gold, dark charcoal ribbed beanie, small goatee, huge patched olive coat over dark hoodie and stained white shirt, round gold medallion, braided bracelets, patched baggy dark brown trousers, distressed cream/black/red high-top sneakers with red laces. His enormous rugged olive backpack has a gray bedroll strapped across the top, dangling metal tin cup, red cloth tag and brown straps. Preserve these distinctive props and colors.
0–0.7s: establish whole character in a low lunge. THREE large freestanding charcoal padded punching dummies with rust-red seams converge toward him from three different depths, with no floor or mounting stands. He catches the backpack strap with a defiant grin.
0.7–2.6s: he swings the loaded olive backpack off one shoulder and whips it around his body once like a wrecking ball. Camera pulls sharply out to expose the huge circular reach. The same backpack expands comically to refrigerator size at the far end of the stretched strap, its bedroll and tin cup still recognizable. ONE fast continuous sweep flattens all THREE approaching dummies in sequence: THUD, THUD, enormous final KLANG. The last dummy sails away shrinking into the cyan distance while two others tumble apart. Bounded burnt-orange/ivory curved speed strokes and three separate jagged impact stars, no ground crack, backdrop or additional characters.
2.6–3.5s: the bag recoils back to its normal size; he swings it smoothly onto BOTH shoulders and catches his balance in a strong planted-looking full-body stance without rendering a floor. Snap-zoom toward his grin as exact title STILL STANDING slams across the lower composition.
3.5–5s: ease out to full body. He adjusts one backpack strap as though nothing happened. The little tin cup swings once and CLINKS against the buckle; he catches it instantly with two fingers and gives the camera a tiny victorious nod. Hold face and title. SFX: fabric strain, rapidly swelling circular whoosh, three escalating dummy hits, deep last impact, strap recoil, title slam, isolated tin-cup clink. No speech or music.
